{{Top|leg}}
The '''hyoid bone''' was located near a [[Human/Legends|Human's]] [[Throat/Legends|throat]]. A fractured hyoid bone was often fatal, and this frequently happened to victims of [[Telekinesis/Legends#Choking powers|Force choke]], such as [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]].
